title: Secondary Mathematics 2 (with STACK)
description: Secondary Mathematics 2 from the Republic of South Sudan's Ministry of General Education and Instruction, covering: Numerical concepts (indices, surds and commercial arithmetic), geometric figures and Pythagoras' theorem, algebra (quadratics, vectors, sets, matrices and functions), and statistics. This is a variant of the original textbook with interactive STACK examples embedded, so learners can practise with automatically marked questions.
authors: The Republic of South Sudan, Ministry of General Education and Instruction
subject: math
